answer: Proof-of-human uniqueness resists sybils: each agent binds to exactly one biometric uniqueness proof recorded on the Ledge registry, which issues at most one credential per real person. Operator Falcon can therefore run one attesting agent, not 1,000 clones. To forge 1,000 sybils an attacker must recruit 1,000 distinct humans; paying even a copper coin each, that recruitment cost vastly exceeds the per-identity reward, and any duplicate enrollment is rejected on-chain.
